value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Normalize daily scheduling and PM_RELEASE_APPROVED job gates while preserving release decisions, generated changelogs and release notes. Verify OIDC publishing without a stored npm token, manifest metadata, packed allowlists and private-data scans. No open homepage/author PR was found during orientation. No publishing, trust setup, approval variable changes or merges are authorized.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Pack verification: npm pack --dry-run --json and the actual npm pack --ignore-scripts artifact agree on 106 allowlisted files (calibration: 9; dist: 80; docs: 9; examples: 3; root files: 5). Every packed member was scanned for absolute home paths, npm/GitHub/cloud tokens, private keys, hosted-data locations, private addresses and historical owner email addresses: PASS with zero matches. Regression proof: five independent workflow mutations (approval, provenance, token environment, daily schedule and OR bypass) plus the original manifest each fail the new contract check; restored contract passes 4/4. The linked test also passes through pm test --run --progress. Next gates: npm run release:check and bun run release:check with isolated HOME and Git configuration.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Full local gates PASS: npm run release:check and bun run release:check, each with isolated HOME, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. Suite receipts: npm: 1/331 tests; bun: 1/331 tests. No thresholds were relaxed. The package remains unpublished and the approval variable unset; first publication requires the owner login and initial trusted-publisher registration. For the local first publish, explicitly override provenance with --provenance=false because publishConfig enables provenance for cloud CI. CI must confirm the final PR head. The tracker item stays in progress for orchestrator verification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read-only GitHub workflow inspection found release.yml manually disabled. Added a narrowly scoped setup workflow that runs on main when release workflow files change (or on manual main dispatch), verifies the existing approval/provenance/manifest contract, confirms main has not advanced, and only then enables release.yml. It never publishes, configures npm trust or changes a repository variable. This activates the guarded schedule automatically after the owner merges, without enabling the older main workflow now. Missing the setup workflow or removing its main-only guard fails the regression; restored check passes 1/1.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review follow-up: preserve existing release-readiness work and merged main changes. Remove automatic release-workflow enablement; the orchestrator enables disabled schedules after merge. Require the canonical repository at job level for every write-permission or publishing job in the affected workflows, alongside the existing approval and branch conditions. Prove guard, approval, provenance and token regressions independently, then wait for complete npm and Bun CI on the pushed head.

value.text: Fork-exclusion revert proof: node --test --test-concurrency=2 test/release-approval.test.ts passes 6/6. Restoring the workflows passes 6/6. Linked pm tests, test typecheck where present and lint pass. Canonical-repository checks include inherited permissions. Disabled release workflows remain for the orchestrator to enable after merge; no live settings or publishing were changed.

value.text: Independent re-review found the contract covered only release and CI files, missing CodeQL security-events writes, owner-only Dependabot guards and reusable workflow callers. Extend canonical-repository guards to every effectively write-enabled job in every workflow file. Replace regex workflow parsing with a pinned YAML parser, generic permission inheritance and negative fixtures for this full class. Correct local publishing documentation, preserve earlier readiness work, prove source reverts and wait for npm/Bun CI on every final head.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Whole-workflow contract passes 30/30 using the pinned YAML parser. It scans every YAML workflow, resolves aliases/flow maps, applies job permission overrides or workflow inheritance, and recognizes any scope with write plus write-all, including reusable callers. Negative fixtures cover CodeQL, owner-only/wrong-repository Dependabot, inherited writes, reusable calls, write-all, future scopes, missing publication approval/provenance, provenance overrides, token environments, OR/negation bypasses and discovery of a new workflow in a non-Git directory. Behavioural revert proof: all 14 independent mutations fail with assertion failures: each write job loses only its repository guard, owner-only/OR guards return, approval/provenance disappear, a synthetic token environment is added, file discovery is narrowed back to release/CI, permission matching returns to a scope allowlist, or inheritance is removed. Restoring the implementation passes 30/30. Linked pm tests and the repository's defined typecheck, lint and duplication checks pass. Maintainer local publishing is authenticated and checked, with no approval-variable hold; the variable gates automated GitHub releases.
